values.value: NPSP adds households, gifts, recurring donations, relationships and customizable rollups to Salesforce. BarnCRM covers the same ground with its own Core and Giving modules.
Free, open source; runs in a Salesforce org
BarnCRM Core, Giving and Rollup Builder

BarnCRM runs beside NPSP: BarnCRM never changes NPSP records or settings. Move one area at a time. Rollups: the NPSP Customizable Rollups kit copies them into Rollup Builder; never let both fill the same field. Households: Adopt NPSP Households converts them in place. Gifts: with Mirror installed, the NPSP Gifts and Soft Credits kit copies won Opportunities as gifts that remember their Opportunity.
Start Migration, one kit per receiving module, in the order listed; the Migrating From NPSP admin guide page.
